steps.message:
Aha!
`Text: 'Hello \\'`
`Markup: 'Hello \[b]World[/b]'`
The result of `escape("Hello \")` was `"Hello \"`.
When concatenated with `"[b]World[/b]"`, it became `"Hello \[b]World[/b]"`.
And `\[b]` is an escaped tag, so the `[b]` is treated as literal text.
Then the `[/b]` is treated as a closing tag, but there was no opening tag.
